sermon.title: We Can’t Experience Eternal Life Without It Changing Our Life That Now Is 10/27/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that eternal life and this life are directly proportional: you cannot know God without it changing how you live now. Jesus told the rich man to keep the commandments. Knowing God shows in honoring parents, loving others, refusing false witness and idols, and assembling together. We know Him if we keep His commandments.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics and claims about public figures are kept as spoken and were not checked.

Now. When I was a boy my parents got saved and I can remember even though I was only four or five years old I can remember to this day they were getting baptized and they had like a white sheet on them or something in the kentucky oh yeah okay in the kentucky river I didn’t know a hill of beans what was going on but I noticed immediately there was a big change in my father. Number one he quit smoking every morning I can hear him hacking huh. Going to the toilet you know in a few months no hacking I. Remember gagging when he smoked in the house I mean ii hate cigarette smoke yeah man it was so nice to be in a house with no gagging.

Now see I didn’t understand it as a boy but I saw the end result and they started going to church. And time went by and let me tell you they would go to those country folks in my dad dad worked in the coal mine and you know he shoveled coal all day. Hard work after walking out of a hollow to get a ride and walk him back in at the end of the day the hard-working man. Yet. He would come home clean up and go to church and take us with him I did a lot of sleeping on the pews they didn’t have pews benches or something ain’t happy nothing comfortable about it. And these people would sing you know just over in the glory land I was John and the body ain’t over yeah it’s singing no victory and I mean and I.

So ignited and so strengthened by what people mocked and laughed at. When you don’t know him it’s easy to mock it’s easy to laugh it’s easy as a pic but when you know him you’re going to respond its directly going to affect your life here.

Hallelujah. But on that day it shall be what and you whoa there’s a difference here these people that I meet and they have the Holy Ghost by faith if you have the Holy Ghost by faith you don’t have the Holy Ghost.
